title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.69
summary: Fix TMP go2rtc broker build on classic Docker 20.10 and show verified cameras progressively during bounded discovery.
changes: Fix go2rtc Docker build failing because classic Docker leaves BUILDPLATFORM blank
Test classic Docker build with DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 in CI
Guarantee per-request and per-host camera discovery deadlines
Show verified camera results before entire search completes
Preserve camera settings, recordings and go2rtc race-fixed broker
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.69
description: Classic-Docker compatible TMP Hardened Media Broker and bounded-progress camera network discovery.
releaseNotes: Includes the go2rtc concurrent map write crash fix from 2.20.68 with native-architecture classic Docker builds. Camera scan uses absolute network request and 12s per-host fingerprint deadlines, and returns verified camera results before the last host finishes. Preserves .env, recordings and camera database. Direct update compatible from 2.20.32.
